title: Mekanism: Water Generator Rebuild
description: A mod that adds a water source with a maximum integer value (2.1 billion), in the style of the Mekanism mod.
body: ## **A mod that adds a block with a maximum integer value (approximately 2.1 billion) of water, in the style of Mekanism Mod.** This mod is essentially an improved version of MamaeMDL's Mekanism Atmospheric Water Generator. The aforementioned mod adds 2.1 billion water sources contained within a single block, but it is made with MCreator and is a mod that can cause compatibility issues. While that fact itself isn't problematic, there is a significant issue: it does not indicate in its category or description that it was made with MCreator. This led me to create the Mekanism Water Generator Rebuild. ## Design ![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1396471/description_075807f0-9c22-4d8c-9941-815d91cb50bf.png) Compared to the Cooking for Blockheads mod, this one might be easier to get used to the mechanics. But since I'm not great at modeling, if you can provide a better model, I'd really appreciate it if you could send me a message via the author's Twitter DM (@WKSHY\_)! :) ## Thanks to **_srl_flyt_** for providing them!! :D Oh, I forgot! We abbreviate modid as mwgr to keep things short! Since it can be confusing, we recommend searching for mods like JEI using keywords like “water” or “generator”!
